The API SLA risk calculation logic passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the mathematical implementation is sound.

Pytest 8.4.1 successfully validated the logic in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the core calculation is reusable, the lower judge reward suggests potential for improving code documentation or edge-case handling beyond the primary success path.
